## Goal
Finish `threetched-consolidation-fusion-20261018` / OD-121 in `/srv/git/odbus-verified`. Preserve the completed 33-method consolidation. Reconcile already completed GNU workspace build, isolated catalog and generated specialization rather than repeating them. Fix demonstrated remaining consumers, record exact release evidence and stop without live activation.

## Constraints & Preferences
- JEV is **judge only**, native `typesafe/jev-latest`. Never activate/retest class-router, choose Cargo-specific models, change provider configuration or global routing.
- Preserve shared dirty source and other agents’ ownership. Never reset/stash/restore removed wrappers.
- No tests, checks, Clippy, formatting checks, `/verify`, custom smoke fixtures, installs, service actions or live activation.
- No identity/grant/storage/network changes. Guard/storage remains OFF.
- Latest separate provisioning ownership explicitly says **DO NOT RESTORE ANYTHING WITHOUT EXPLICIT PERMISSION**. Do not repair the current release/service incident under consolidation scope.
- One Cargo process at a time. Historical PIDs are not current ownership evidence. Reconcile terminal receipts first; perform one immediate exclusion observation only if a genuinely necessary authorized build remains.
- Authorized release command, repository root:
  ```sh
  CXXFLAGS="-include cstdint" cargo build --workspace --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
  ```
- Use only freshly built GNU `opblob seal-plugins <new-catalog-dir>` for any necessary isolated seal. No live seal, stale mixed artifacts, cargo install/publish.
- Long-running actual commands must be detached from chat process group, stdin closed, persistent logs and durable terminal receipt. Execution worker must not recursively delegate. Do not poll builds.
- Preserve SID1/OIA1, exact capability alternatives, private partitions, MutationEngine complete-tree SHM commits, cancellation and operation receipts.
- No invented native endpoints/`threetched.Chat`, parallel schema, duplicate control plane or relocating facades into LLM.
- OD-122 personas/config and OD-123 Cozo/native-memory remain deferred. Cognitive HOT-policy aliases are separate migration debt.
- Read applicable mandatory skills independently for workers. Do not start rust-analyzer if it triggers incidental Cargo checks.
- Use JEV relevance filtering before full candidate reads. Report only actual evidence, distinguishing source/built/sealed/deployed/tested.
